Butter Chicken

.cook
👥 4 servings ⏱️ Prep Time: 15 minutes 🔥 Cook Time: 30 minutes 📖 https://foodima.org/easy-butter-chicken/

🥘 Ingredients

Chicken Marinade

  • Kashmiri chili
    1 tsp
  • chicken breast
    2 lb
  • coriander
    1/2 tsp
  • cumin
    1 tsp
  • curry powder
    1 tsp
  • garam masala
    1 tsp
  • garlic cloves (minced)
    5
  • ginger powder
    1/2 tsp
  • lemon juice (juice of 1 lemon)
    1
  • oil
    2 tbsp
  • pepper
  • salt
  • yogurt
    2 tbsp

Final Sauce

  • Kashmiri chili
    1 tsp
  • butter
    3 tbsp
  • chicken broth
    2-1/2 cups
  • chili flakes
    1 tsp
  • cilantro (chopped)
  • cinnamon stick
  • cumin
    1/2 tsp
  • garam masala
    1 tsp
  • garlic cloves (minced)
    4
  • ginger powder
    1/4 tsp
  • heavy cream
    2/3 cups
  • lemon slices
  • oil
    2 tbsp
  • pepper
  • red onion (diced)
    1 large
  • salt
  • tomato paste
    2 tbsp

🍳 Cookware

  • large pan

Chicken Marinade

  1. 1
    Wash the chicken breast and pat dry with paper towel, then remove any excess water.
    chicken breast: 2 lb
  2. 2
    Add in Kashmiri chili and lemon juice first. Let this sit for a few minutes, then add all the other marinade ingredients: garlic cloves , oil , garam masala , curry powder , cumin , ginger powder , coriander , salt , pepper , and yogurt .
    Kashmiri chili: 1 tsp, lemon juice: 1 (juice of 1 lemon), garlic cloves: 5 (minced), oil: 2 tbsp, garam masala: 1 tsp, curry powder: 1 tsp, cumin: 1 tsp, ginger powder: 1/2 tsp, coriander: 1/2 tsp, salt, pepper, yogurt: 2 tbsp
  3. 3
    Marinate the chicken in the fridge for at least ⏱️ 1 hour .

Final Sauce

  1. 1
    After marinating, take a large pan or pot, add oil and put it on medium heat. Once oil heats up, add the chicken pieces. Cook the chicken for ⏱️ 2-3 minutes on each side. Remove and set aside.
    oil: 2 tbsp
  2. 2
    In the same pan, add butter and red onion . Also add a cinnamon stick and cook for ⏱️ 5-6 minutes or until the onions turn brown.
    butter: 3 tbsp, red onion: 1 large (diced), cinnamon stick
  3. 3
    After frying the onions, add cumin , ginger powder , garlic cloves , garam masala , chili flakes , and Kashmiri chili . Let cook for another ⏱️ 1 minute .
    cumin: 1/2 tsp, ginger powder: 1/4 tsp, garlic cloves: 4 (minced), garam masala: 1 tsp, chili flakes: 1 tsp, Kashmiri chili: 1 tsp
  4. 4
    Add tomato paste , salt , pepper , and chicken broth . Cook and let simmer until it turns into a thick sauce. You can blend this sauce for a smooth consistency; add water if necessary.
    tomato paste: 2 tbsp, salt, pepper, chicken broth: 2-1/2 cups
  5. 5
    Return the chicken to the pan and mix well with the sauce. Add heavy cream and let simmer for ⏱️ 8-10 minutes .
    heavy cream: 2/3 cups
  6. 6
    Garnish with fresh cilantro and lemon slices . Serve with bread, rice, or salad.
    cilantro (chopped), lemon slices
